scoring_rules.json.scientific_requirements: Only independent final scientific propositions receive points, with one rule per proposition and a total of 100. Each item is full credit on pass and zero on fail; need_review is unresolved and does not count as success. All required final propositions must pass for whole-case success. Genuine linked calculations or reproducible scientific analysis must support the stated conclusion; copied supplied observations or author targets are not newly established results. Check composition, state, mapping, observable, units, environment and reference before comparison. Structures, frequencies, native outputs and model-validity checks qualify the dependent conclusion and receive no independent points. No process, workflow, job-count, software-use, chronology, resource-use or report-completeness score applies. Scientifically established equivalent explanations pass directly. Use need_review only for the item-specific supported but unresolved scientific conflicts below; missing work, guessing, incorrect identity/reference/units and hard-window failures are fail. Numerical windows are fixed inclusive absolute criteria, not fitted to local results. Contextual source values in semantic items do not create hidden numeric gates. AR chooses its methods independently; PR must establish applicability to its disclosed author baseline, or justify a scientifically comparable substitution. This is a comparability condition, not process credit.

rules.expected: For chemically balanced acid/base models with the C30N6O4 skeleton, explain the observed acid-to-base red shift through genuine vertical water-optical calculations identifying the dominant absorbing transitions. The base dominant transition is lower in energy; the acid and base bright bands are predominantly pi→pi-star with important HOMO→LUMO contributions involving the azobenzene moieties and isoDPP core. Identify physical transition character and intensity rather than requiring source root numbers or pure single configurations. The computed energy/intensity/transition evidence is support for this optical explanation, not three independent author-node scores. Use one declared response consistently, separating corrected-LR energies from uncorrected LR stages. The source observed wavelengths alone do not establish the explanation; no exact excitation-energy/oscillator-strength window is imposed.

binding.comparison: Evaluate this explicit final proposition from genuine linked native evidence and its physical definitions. Evidence prerequisites do not earn points. Do not impose an undisclosed author route or model.

Absolute acid-shift agreement is not required because source theory already differs from experiment.

rules.expected: Use the joint spatial and observable constraints to assign the molecular response to phenolic protonation/deprotonation, with explicit changes of proton number, charge and electron count relative to the neutral parent. This item scores the species-level inference and what is identifiable, not a second award for the separately assessed optical/NMR signs or hydrazone result. Explain why local phenolic-adjacent proton shifts and the delocalized optical response constrain the responsive functionality, yet do not by themselves fix unique solution protonation sites or populations.
